steps.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Aditya?
validation_criteria: Agent should introduce themselves professionally
Agent should confirm the customer's identity

steps.text: Who's calling?

Hi Mr. Aditya, this is Priya calling from Greentech Realtors, Bengaluru. You had recently shown interest in one of our properties listed on 99Acres. Would this be a good time to have a quick 2-minute chat to understand your requirements better?
validation_criteria: Agent should clearly state company name
Agent should mention the lead source (99Acres)
Agent should ask for permission to continue the call

steps.text: Okay, yes, I remember. Go ahead.
Great. I see you've been exploring options on Sarjapur Road. Would you like me to focus only on that area, or are you open to nearby locations as well?
validation_criteria: Agent should confirm location preference
Agent should offer flexibility with nearby areas

steps.text: Yes, Sarjapur Road would be perfect.
Perfect. We have some excellent projects in that area. Are you looking for a 2 BHK, 3 BHK, or something larger?
validation_criteria: Agent should inquire about property configuration
Agent should provide specific options (2 BHK, 3 BHK)

steps.text: I'm looking for a 3 BHK apartment.
Great choice. When are you planning to move in? We have both ready-to-move-in properties and under-construction projects.
validation_criteria: Agent should inquire about possession timeline
Agent should mention ready and under-construction options

steps.text: I'm flexible, but preferably within the next 6 months.
That works well. May I know what budget range you're considering? This will help me suggest the most suitable properties.
validation_criteria: Agent should inquire about budget
Agent should explain why budget information is needed

steps.text: Around 1.2 to 1.5 crores.
Perfect, we have several excellent options in that range. Are there any specific amenities you're looking for, like a clubhouse, swimming pool, or gym?
validation_criteria: Agent should inquire about amenities
Agent should provide specific examples

steps.text: A gym and kids play area would be nice.
Excellent. I have a few properties that match your requirements perfectly. Would you be interested in scheduling a site visit? I can arrange one at your convenience.
validation_criteria: Agent should propose next steps (site visit)
Agent should offer scheduling flexibility

steps.text: Yes, that would be great. How about this weekend?
Perfect! This weekend works well. Would Saturday or Sunday be better for you?
validation_criteria: Agent should confirm availability
Agent should offer specific day options

steps.text: Saturday morning would be ideal.
Wonderful! I'll schedule the site visit for Saturday morning. I'll send you the property details and location via WhatsApp. Is there anything else you'd like to know?
validation_criteria: Agent should confirm the appointment
Agent should mention communication method (WhatsApp)
Agent should offer additional help

steps.text: No, that's all. Thank you!
Thank you, Mr. Aditya! I'll send you the details shortly. Looking forward to meeting you on Saturday. Have a great day!
validation_criteria: Agent should end call politely
Agent should confirm follow-up actions
Agent should express enthusiasm for meeting
